name: Nelsim - Toke of Love
source:
Nelsim: A Toke of Love is the visual novel that puts you in the driver's seat of the story.

As Nelson, you'll navigate the twists and turns of college life,  discovering love interests along the way. But be careful, every decision you make will determine Nelson's joys, struggles, and adventures.

Will you focus on your studies?  Will you pursue a relationship with one or more of the charming women of Laynster?

Nelsim: A Toke of Love offers a rich and engaging storyline, with vaporwave inspired visuals and music that will transport you into Nelson's world. But be warned: your decisions will have real consequences, shaping the course of the story and the fate of the characters. Will you find love, success, and happiness, or will you hit a dead end?

[From [url=https://brabraden.itch.io/nelsim]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Nelsim：A Toke of Love》是一部视觉小说，让你掌控故事的发展。

作为尼尔森，你将经历曲折的大学生活，并一路发现爱情兴趣。但要小心，你所做的每一个决定都将决定尼尔森的欢乐、挣扎和冒险。

你会专注于你的学业吗？你会与兰斯特的一位或多位迷人女性建立关系吗？

《尼尔森：爱情之戒》提供了丰富而引人入胜的故事情节，以及受蒸汽波启发的视觉效果和音乐，将你带入尼尔森的世界。但请注意：你的决定将产生真正的后果，塑造故事的进程和角色的命运。你会找到爱情、成功和幸福，还是会陷入死胡同？

[来自[url=https://brabraden.itch.io/nelsim]Itch.io[/url]]
